title: Accession of Nabopolassar in Babylon
summary: Nabopolassar becomes king of Babylon, founding the Neo-Babylonian (Chaldean) dynasty.
description: Nabopolassar becomes king of Babylon, founding the Neo-Babylonian (Chaldean) dynasty. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 626 BC (AP-83, OSF preprint CFAH-14)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, p. 15, heading "Nabopolassar - 626 BC - Anchor Point #83"
chronologies.note: CFAH-5 gives Nabopolassar's accession as 626/625 BC, and AP-45 begins Dynasty 8 in 626.
